name: base_utils
description: Shared operating-system utility module that optionally manages /etc/motd from a template and installs a configurable list of utility packages.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Python application deployment profile that builds a database URL, installs Python and database prerequisites, deploys an application repository, configures a systemd service, and enables monitoring and logging-related configuration.

name: profile_haproxy
description: HAProxy load-balancer profile that installs the package, generates configuration, manages the service, integrates with the firewall, and supports discovery, statistics, logging, security settings, and data-driven backends.

name: profile_postgresql
description: PostgreSQL installation profile that configures the package repository, installs pinned PostgreSQL packages, and starts and enables the database service.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Redis profile for clustered or discovered deployments with configurable port, authentication, memory limits, eviction policy, and PuppetDB-based node discovery.

name: site profiles and roles
description: Composition layer defining base operating-system behavior and deployable roles for application servers, application stacks, HAProxy nodes, and Redis nodes.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Supporting custom Puppet function namespace that provides PuppetDB query behavior used by the Redis profile.
